save face: After making a big mistake in front of everyone, the manager tried to save face by blaming the computer system.
在大家面前犯了大錯後，經理試圖怪罪電腦系統來保住面子。
save one's breath: You can save your breath; my father has already decided, and nothing you say will change his mind.
你可以省點口舌了；我爸已經決定了，你說什麼都改變不了他的心意。
save the day: When the singer lost her voice, her younger sister stepped onto the stage to save the day.
當歌手失聲時，她的妹妹走上舞台力挽狂瀾。
save time: To save time in the morning, I usually pack my school bag and choose my clothes the night before.
為了在早上省時，我通常前一晚就收好書包、選好衣服。
save for a rainy day: My grandmother always told me to put some money aside and save for a rainy day.
我奶奶總是告訴我要存一些錢，未雨綢繆。
save a seat: Could you save a seat for me in the library? I will be there in about ten minutes.
你可以在圖書館幫我占個位子嗎？我大約十分鐘後到。
save one's skin: Instead of telling the truth, the driver lied to the police to save his skin after the accident.
車禍後，那名司機沒有說實話，而是對警察說謊來保命。
save the best for last: The band decided to save the best for last and played their most famous song at the very end.
樂團決定把好的留到最後，在最後才演唱他們最有名的歌。
scale a mountain: It took the climbers three days to scale a mountain that was more than four thousand meters high.
登山客花了三天才攀登一座超過四千公尺高的山峰。
scale back production: Because fewer people were buying new cars, the factory had to scale back production and cut working hours.
由於買新車的人變少，工廠不得不縮減產量並減少工時。
scale up operations: After its online sales tripled, the small company decided to scale up operations and hire fifty more workers.
網路銷售成長三倍後，這家小公司決定擴大營運，再雇用五十名員工。
scale the heights: With years of hard practice, the young pianist hopes to scale the heights of the music world.
經過多年苦練，這位年輕鋼琴家希望在音樂界登峰造極。
scale down: Because of the heavy rain, the school had to scale down the sports day and hold only a few events indoors.
因為大雨，學校必須縮小運動會的規模，只在室內舉辦幾個項目。
on a large scale: The government plans to plant trees on a large scale to fight air pollution in the city.
政府計畫大規模植樹，以對抗城市的空氣污染。
scan the horizon: Every morning the sailor would scan the horizon from the deck, hoping to see land after weeks at sea.
每天早上水手都會從甲板上掃視地平線，希望在海上漂流數週後能看到陸地。
scan a document: If you scan a document and email it to me, I can sign it without coming to the office.
如果你掃描文件並用電子郵件寄給我，我不用進辦公室就能簽名。
scan the headlines: Every morning, my dad likes to scan the headlines on his phone while drinking his coffee.
每天早上，我爸喜歡邊喝咖啡邊在手機上瀏覽標題。
scan for errors: Before handing in your essay, scan for errors in spelling and grammar that you might have missed.
交作文之前，要檢查你可能漏掉的拼字和文法錯誤。
scan the crowd: The worried mother began to scan the crowd at the night market, looking for her son's red jacket.
焦急的媽媽開始在夜市掃視人群，尋找她兒子的紅色夾克。
be scarred by war: Many soldiers are scarred by war and carry painful memories that never fully heal, even decades later.
許多士兵因戰爭留下創傷，即使數十年後，痛苦的記憶仍無法完全癒合。
scar the landscape: Local people protested that the huge mine would scar the landscape and destroy the beauty of the valley.
當地居民抗議這座巨大的礦場會破壞景觀，毀掉山谷的美景。
emotionally scarred: The girl was emotionally scarred after being bullied at school, and she found it hard to trust people.
那女孩在學校被霸凌後心靈受創，很難再信任別人。
scarred for life: The terrible car accident left him scarred for life, and he still refuses to sit in the front seat.
那場可怕的車禍讓他留下永久創傷，他至今仍拒絕坐在前座。
scatter seeds: In spring, the farmer walked across the field to scatter seeds by hand, just like his father did.
春天時，農夫走過田地用手撒種，就像他父親以前那樣。
the crowd scattered: When the heavy rain suddenly started, the crowd scattered and people ran to find shelter.
當大雨突然落下，群眾四散，人們跑去找地方躲雨。
scatter one's ashes: Following her wishes, the family went to the beach to scatter her ashes into the sea she loved.
依照她的遺願，家人到海邊把她的骨灰撒進她深愛的大海。
scattered showers: The weather report says there will be scattered showers this afternoon, so bring an umbrella just in case.
氣象報告說今天下午會有零星陣雨，所以帶把傘以防萬一。
scattered across the country: The company has more than two hundred stores scattered across the country, from big cities to small towns.
這家公司有兩百多家分店散布全國，從大城市到小鎮都有。
